note: Mod Menu 7.2.2 reads TitleScreen.field_32271 (the Realms button text) and compares it with a button label. 1.21.1 made the field private, so the direct GETSTATIC throws IllegalAccessError. The bridge reads it through reflection.

fieldRedirects.evidence: ModMenuEventHandler.shiftButtons throws 'IllegalAccessError: tried to access private field net.minecraft.class_442.field_32271' on 1.21.1 (runs/p88-mod-expansion/EXPANSION-REPORT.md). Reflection keeps the comparison behaviour.

methodRenames.evidence: 1.21.1 made ButtonWidget.render (class_339.method_25394) final and moved the override point to the protected renderWidget (class_4264.method_48579). The child override caused IncompatibleClassChangeError on title-screen init (runs/p92-modmenu/); renaming keeps the update-badge drawing and rewrites the super call to the new hook.
